classes.name: Odysseus of Ithaca
classes.blurb: King of Ithaca, ten years at Troy, and still not home. The wooden horse was your idea. You have never won a fight you could win another way, which is fortunate, because nothing in this cave can be won by fighting. A short sword you will barely draw, pitch-pine to hold back the dark, and the grey-eyed goddess watching over your shoulder. The strong wine of Maron waits in the hold below; the men will carry it up when the moment comes.

classes.name: Polites, First Through the Door
classes.blurb: The dearest of the captain's companions, always the first to step into a strange hall and the last to leave a friend behind. You lead with your shield and your open hand, not your edge. On this island that courage will be tested in the worst way a brave man can be tested: by being told to hide, to wait, to make no sound at all. Somewhere in the ship's hold is a skin of Maron's dark wine, kept against the day a stranger must be made a guest.

classes.name: Eurybates, the King's Herald
classes.blurb: Round-shouldered, dark-skinned, wool-haired, and the one man Odysseus honours above the rest of the crew because he thinks like the captain does. A herald carries words, not war, and words are the only weapon worth the name in this cave. Your horn bow is for the dark of the pens, not for the thing that keeps them. Down in the ship the wine of Maron is stowed and waiting, a gift for a host who has never learned the word.
